competitor_benchmark.rationale: Four pages from the observed top ten were captured in full and benchmarked passage by passage against Garmin's own documentation and primary physiology sources (research.md section 3). The default sample is the three highest-ranking pages whose job matches the reader task and the explainer format; those are Garmin's technology page (position 2), Garmin's support FAQ (position 6) and Garmin's blog (position 8). The FAQ returned HTTP 403 to curl and WebFetch during research and was captured afterwards by the orchestrator as rendered page text in the desktop browser pane, then added to the set. Sonar Health (position 10), the only third-party explainer on the SERP and the format peer the planned article will compete with for a non-Garmin slot, was retained rather than displaced, so the sample is four pages by a disclosed enlargement, not a replacement. The vivoactive 5 owner's manual at position 7 is a 200-word reference entry rather than an explainer; it was captured and is used as evidence E2 and benchmarked by passage. Every other top-ten organic, discussion or video row is excluded with a reason; Reddit and Facebook rows could not be read (login walls) and the Garmin video is not an article. Positions are from the primary query's SERP dated 2026-10-20; the secondary query 'garmin training readiness' (SERP dated 2026-09-25) has no article in its organic top ten and no Garmin documentation outside AI Overview sources, so no competitor was selected from it; its rows are recorded in research.md section 3.
